messages:
carla: quick sync — proposing a phased unpin of runtime-2.14 for the llama3q family. we saw perf regressions fixed in 2.15 but want a safe plan.

mike: +1. main risk is SDK compatibility for teams still on sdk 1.4.x (kv cache/layout change). we need a fallback shim or pinlist exception window.

cheng: the shim is small but touches KV serialization. able to push 1.5.1-canary with compatibility flag in ~48h. it will opt-in via header: X-RW-KV-LEGACY=1

maureen: operational plan suggestion:
- phase A: dry-run (internal traffic only) 2h
- phase B: staged canary 5% external 6h
- phase C: ramp 25% 12h
- phase D: full unpin after 48h of healthy metrics
I can own the rollout and the rollback playbook.

carla: sounds good. add guard rails: 5xx > 0.5% OR token latency p95 > 2x baseline for >10m triggers rollback. also block for long-seq regression >3% in quality checks.

sre-oncall: I'll add alerts. alarms to set:
- errors.http.5xx > 0.5% (15m)
- latency.tokens.p95 > 2x (15m)
- kernel-timeout.count > 0 (immediate)
I will mute noisy tests during the dry-run.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] canary job created by carla: canary-id=canary-1767773333, targets=redwood-internal, start=2025-03-18T22:30:00Z

mike: one more thing — add a temporary pinlist exception for customers using sdk 1.4 with long-seq workload; we'll send CS template. we should not auto-route them to runtime-2.15 until SDK shim is out.

cheng: noted. plan: ship 1.5.1-canary today, monitor for 24h, then promote if green. 1.5.1 will include the legacy flag and a small compatibility test in CI.

maureen: CS template draft (short):
"We're scheduling a small change to runtime routing for llama3q models. If you rely on SDK 1.4 and long-sequence workloads, please reply and we'll keep your traffic on pinned runtime until you upgrade or opt into the compatibility shim."

carla: please add the specific header snippet we mentioned for customers who want to opt-in in the template. good to warn about slight perf delta with the shim.

deploy-bot: [info] dry-run started (internal): canary-1767773333-phaseA at 2025-03-18T22:30:00Z

sre-oncall: dry-run metrics: errors.http.5xx=0.03%, latency.tokens.p95=0.95x baseline, longseq-quality-regressions=0

cheng: good sign. starting 1.5.1-canary CI now.

maureen: creating rollback runbook page now: /runbooks/unpin-runtime-1767773333.md (internal link). includes steps: pin-back command, route-sync, revoke rollout, notify customers.

mike: pin-back command for reference:
```
deploy-bot pin runtime --id runtime-2.14 --reason "rollback: regressions" --ttl 72h
```

carla: after phase B completes, we'll review telemetry and small sample of customer logs for unexpected decoding errors. if everything looks stable, we proceed to phase C tonight.

deploy-bot: [status] phaseB (5% external) started: canary-1767773333-phaseB at 2025-03-19T04:30:00Z

sre-oncall: phaseB snapshot (30m): errors.http.5xx=0.21% (below 0.5%), latency.tokens.p95=1.05x baseline, kernel-timeout.count=0

maureen: thanks. I'm sending the CS template to the list now and adding the opt-in header snippet.

cheng: CI shows no serialization failures. promoting 1.5.1-canary to canary ramp for SDK tests.

carla: decision: proceed to phase C (25% ramp) in 30m. if metrics hold for 12h, schedule full unpin for morning maintenance window (48h verification).

deploy-bot: [action] scheduled roll: canary-1767773333-phaseC start=2025-03-19T05:00:00Z target=25%

sre-oncall: I'll keep on-call dragged in for the first 3h of phaseC. alert thresholds unchanged.

mike: reminder for release notes: call out SDK shim opt-in header, expected perf tradeoffs, and migration path to 1.5.1. I'll draft the note.

maureen: update: CS replies — two customers requested to stay pinned until they test. added them to exception list.

carla: OK — exception list recorded. we'll exclude them from routing during ramp.

deploy-bot: [update] phaseC ramp complete, metric check at +3h shows no regressions. unpin scheduled: 2025-03-21T08:00:00Z pending final review.

carla: final check tomorrow morning; if no new alerts, we lift the pin and close the rollout ticket. thanks all. :tada:
